Questions arise over Mojtaba Khamenei's whereabouts amid conflicting claims

Speculation has intensified regarding the location of Mojtaba Khamenei, the son of Iran's Supreme Leader. Reports suggest he is not in Iran, with some claims originating from Israeli sources questioning the authenticity of recent messages attributed to him. The situation has generated significant attention and discussion.
